messages:
Nora W: Quick user feedback from field testing on small phones — the condensed toolbar (around 600-660px) looks like a label, users aren't tapping it. We need a stronger affordance. Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots/condensed-toolbar-ux.png :eyes:

Ishan P: Seen this in lab too. Chevron alone isn't discoverable. Two quick options: a visible drag handle + small transient hint, or an always-visible micro affordance like a chevron inside a pill with a subtle shadow. Prefer the drag handle for discoverability.

Clara T: Drag handle is good but must be keyboard-accessible. Add tabindex=0 and role=button with aria-label="Open navigation". Also ensure focus-visible styles (44px min touch target). For motion: animate only opacity/translateY and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Nora W: UX note: product needs the current model visible. Proposed compact copy: show model name shortened (one line) + chevron, and show a one-time tooltip "Tap to switch" the first time user sees it. Track metric for how often its opened.

Ishan P: Technical: we'll expose --nav-height as a CSS var so sticky headers can offset dynamically. Quick snippet: `document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--nav-height', nav.offsetHeight + 'px')` on open/resize.

Clara T: Also hit a couple overflow cases in Runs table: long source IDs cause horizontal scroll at ~640px. Suggest clamp cell to 2 lines with ellipsis and surface a tiny "View" micro-action when truncated. On mobile, long-press shows full text + copy.

QA Bot: Visual test flagged toolbar vs toast z-index at 602px (regression id: z-602-2026-03-23). Also keyboard-nav test: handle missing focus ring when tabbing.

Ishan P: For z-index, easiest is to move toasts to top-right on widths < 680px. Simpler than juggling z-index during transitions. Clara, can you add focus styles?

Clara T: Yep — will add `.handle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); border-radius: 8px; }` and tabindex. Also will implement long-press helper (500ms) for mobile tooltips and a `title` attribute fallback for desktop.

Nora W: Gesture conflict: swipe-to-open from condensed toolbar sometimes triggers table horizontal scroll. Let's require the vertical drag to be more pronounced: require dy > dx * 1.2 and dy > 30px before opening. gesture-bot: can you test?

gesture-bot: Added threshold rule to preview build: `if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 1.2 && Math.abs(dy) > 30) openNav()` — tests passing on emulators, still failing one tablet repro where touch sampling is noisy.

Ishan P: We'll add a small 24px deadzone from the content edge so table swipes near the main area don't trigger the handle. Also animate the handle only, not layout, to avoid reflow.

Clara T: Copy tweak: instead of "Models" show `Model: <name>` only on narrow screens to disambiguate. Keep it short. I'll draft copy in the PR.

QA Bot: Re-run scheduled after changes. Action items: Clara add accessible handle + long-press tooltip, Ishan expose --nav-height + deadzone, Nora to add metric tag for first-time hint, QA to validate on devices. Will review in tomorrow's mobile sync. :thumbsup:
